marker.step_source:
import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

Done: Ctrl+Shift+M never advances the review walk. A landed move follows the task to its destination note, parks the walk on a path+text-identified resume, and the next `]s`/`[s` lands on the moved row's walk neighbour. Vault is synced at nav 2.7.0.

What changed:

- bob-plugins (nav 2.7.0): new `537-plugin-review-move-park.js` (`reviewResumeRef`, `findReviewResumeIndex`, `buildReviewMoveAnchor`, `planReviewResume`, `parkReviewWalkAfterMove`); `reviewOutcomeResolves` no longer resolves `move`; `planReviewJump` honours the text resume (cursor-on-resume lands, line-fallback ignored, real text hits still win); move commit parks before focusing and always shows the plain `Moved N task(s) to X` toast; `reviewAnsweredKeys` untouched by moves.
- Tests: rewrote the landed-move test, added successor/predecessor/counted/stale/lock-swallow cases plus pure resume/anchor/planner tests. Full suite: 1873 pass, 0 fail; `npm run build:check` clean.
- Docs: `docs/freshness.md` §§6/13, `docs/getting-started.md`, plugin README (2.7.0). New decision `task-move-never-advances-the-walk`; `answering-advances-the-walk` marked superseded-in-part. Follow-up bug bead `bob-cli-4m` filed for the general `reviewAnsweredKeys` line-key fragility.

Manual smoke checklist (Obsidian, Vim normal mode):

- `]s` to a NEXT/PENDING landing, then Ctrl+Shift+M to an area note. Cursor follows the task, toast is plain `Moved 1 task to …`, and after editing in the destination, `]s` lands on the item after the moved one (even the row right below it).
- Same with `2<Ctrl+Shift+M>`.
- `<C-o>` returns to the source seam, and `]s` from there lands on that seam row.
- Ctrl+Alt+F, then immediate Ctrl+Shift+M, is swallowed.
- Ctrl+Alt+F, Alt+N, Ctrl+Shift+Enter, and Task Card commits still advance from a landing.
